texts.li: {A_nameDef} came to the council with the {OFFICE}'s things wrapped in a cloth and set them on the table. "Someone else should carry these for a while," {A_nameDef} said, and didn't sit down.\n\n{B_nameDef} knows enough of the seat's work to keep it going, if the council asks.

[worn] For days {A_nameDef} has been first up and last to bed, and it shows. Questions about the {OFFICE}'s work get answered before they're finished, and the answers forgotten by noon. Tonight {A_nameDef} asked the council to find someone else for the seat.\n\n{B_nameDef} could take on the work, at least for a while.

[breaking] {A_nameDef} hasn't been right for a week. The {OFFICE}'s work still gets done, with a set jaw and hands that aren't quite steady. This morning {A_nameDef} asked the council to let the seat go to someone else.\n\n{B_nameDef} could stand in.

[laidup] Ten days in a sickbed, and the work of the {OFFICE} has piled up beside it. {A_nameDef} sent word to the council that the seat ought to go to someone on their feet.\n\n{B_nameDef} could take it on while the council decides.

[lowtech] {A_nameDef} came to the council fire and laid the {OFFICE}'s staff on the ground between them. "I've carried it as far as I can for now," {A_nameDef} said.\n\nThe others looked at {B_nameDef}, who knows the work.

li.label: Let {A_nameDef} step down
li.outcome: The council took the {OFFICE}'s seat back from {A_nameDef} with thanks. It stands empty until the colony votes on it, and {A_nameDef} looked lighter for it before the day was out.

outcomes.li: [laidup] The council took the {OFFICE}'s seat back from {A_nameDef} with thanks, and told {A_objective} to get well first and worry later. The seat stands empty until the colony votes on it.
[lowtech] The council took up the {OFFICE}'s staff from the ground and thanked {A_nameDef} for carrying it. The seat stands empty until the colony chooses again.

li.label: {B_nameDef} stands in for ten days
li.outcome: {B_nameDef} takes on the {OFFICE}'s daily work for ten days, and {A_nameDef} has the day off, starting now. The seat is still {A_nameDef}'s.

outcomes.li: [laidup] {B_nameDef} takes on the {OFFICE}'s daily work for ten days, and {A_nameDef} is told to rest the day through. The seat is still {A_nameDef}'s when {A_pronoun} is back on {A_possessive} feet.

li.label: Ask {A_nameDef} to stay on
li.outcome: The council asked {A_nameDef} to keep the seat a while longer, and {A_nameDef} said yes. Those who trust the council most were glad of it. {A_nameDef} went back to the {OFFICE}'s work no less tired than before.

texts.li: There are {COUNT} {THING} in the stores and two people with plans for all of it. {A_nameDef} asked first, for {WISHA}. {B_nameDef} wants {WISHB}. Either could be made from what there is. Both can't, and neither of them is in a mood to wait.

{A_nameDef} has chalked an outline on the floor for {WISHA}. {B_nameDef} has chalked one over it for {WISHB}. Between them stands the colony's whole stock of {THING}, {COUNT} of it, which will make one or the other.

[lowtech] The {THING} pile behind the workshop holds {COUNT} and no more. {A_nameDef} has been eyeing it for {WISHA} since before {B_nameDef} started eyeing it for {WISHB}, and both have started calling it "my {THING}" when they mean the colony's.

[seat] {HOLDER_nameDef} has counted the {THING} twice, as the {OFFICE} does: {COUNT}, enough for {WISHA} for {A_nameDef}, who asked first, or for {WISHB} for {B_nameDef}, but not both. {HOLDER_nameDef} would like the council to say which before the two of them say it for each other.

li.label: First come, first served: {A_nameDef}'s
li.outcome: The council promised {A_nameDef} {WISHA}, since {A_pronoun} asked first. {B_nameDef}'s wish waits three days longer, and {B_pronoun} will be told why.

outcomes.li: [seat] The council promised {A_nameDef} {WISHA}, since {A_pronoun} asked first, and {HOLDER_nameDef} set the {THING} aside for it as {OFFICE}. {B_nameDef}'s wish waits three days longer, and {HOLDER_nameDef} will tell {B_objective} why.

li.label: {B_nameDef}'s first
li.outcome: The council promised {B_nameDef} {WISHB}, though {A_nameDef} asked first. {A_nameDef}'s wish waits three days longer, and {A_pronoun} will be told why.

outcomes.li: [seat] The council promised {B_nameDef} {WISHB}, though {A_nameDef} asked first, and {HOLDER_nameDef} set the {THING} aside for it as {OFFICE}. {A_nameDef}'s wish waits three days longer, and {HOLDER_nameDef} will tell {A_objective} why.

li.label: Neither until there's more {THING}
li.outcome: The council promised neither. The {THING} stays in the stores, both wishes wait three days longer, and {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} will each be told why.
